stories.title: Abraham Lincoln
stories.summary: Lincoln signed the District of Columbia Compensated Emancipation Act on April 16, 1862, issued the Emancipation Proclamation effective January 1, 1863, and approved the joint resolution sending the Thirteenth Amendment to the states on February 1, 1865.
